selection_policy: Use official gpt-4o-2024-08-06 when OPENAI_API_KEY is present before inference; otherwise use the exact-pinned local 3B fallback. Never switch based on answer or calibration results.

output_schema.parser: case-insensitive exact yes/no with optional terminal period or exclamation mark

abstention_policy: Accept only an explicit identification that the requested information is unavailable or insufficient.
partial_answer_policy: Reject when required information is materially incomplete, except preference questions follow the official rubric rule.
contradiction_policy: Reject a response that adds a materially wrong or contradictory fact.
formal_result_gate: Formal correctness summaries may be generated only when all calibration thresholds and evidence-integrity checks pass.
